Register a ruleset for this session

Source: R/research-rules.R
bg_register_ruleset.Rd

Validates a ruleset and adds it to the session registry, alongside the built-in rulesets shipped in inst/rulesets/. Registering the same id@version again is a no-op if its content is identical and an error otherwise: publish a new version instead.

Usage

bg_register_ruleset(ruleset)

Arguments

ruleset

A ruleset, see bg_ruleset(). A list read from JSON is validated the same way.

Value

The validated ruleset, invisibly.

Examples

bg_register_ruleset(bg_ruleset("lab.empty", "1.0.0"))
bg_rulesets()
#>                    id version             title  origin
#> 1 bayesgrove.workflow   1.0.0 Bayesian workflow builtin
#> 2           lab.empty   1.0.0              <NA> session
#>                                                             digest
#> 1 1d9496979c3d78184ac461fda74562610f3fd48925322be5778460f97f18ab2b
#> 2 507c9f3f5eb68e310410b90cd65225aeef25a3e17fd669711a772895620150a5
